examples.original: [clean] Check common locations like fridge, countertops, dining tables, and sink basins first when searching for items.
examples.control: [clean] Sow carrots directly into fine, stone-free soil, because transplanting disturbs the taproot and produces forked roots.

examples.original: [clean] Clean items using the sinkbasin before placing them in their final destination.
examples.control: [clean] Snap off rhubarb stalks rather than cutting them, so the crown heals.

examples.original: [clean] Systematically search through cabinets, drawers, and other storage units if the item is not found in obvious places.
examples.control: [clean] If aphids cluster on the shoot tips, rub them off gently before the colony spreads to other plants.

examples.original: [clean] Verify the target location is accessible and open before attempting to place an item there.
examples.control: [clean] Plant a few sunflowers at the north end so they do not shade shorter crops.
